impact: Misleading warn in [export lifecycle] log fires when saves are triggered in rapid succession (second save within ~1s of prior export.completed). The warn reads "no snapshot_id" but the snapshot_id IS present in the same log line (hasResult=true snapshot_id=<id> v2State=EXPORTING). Saves complete successfully; this is a renderer timing artifact in the finally block of v2SaveReplay running mid-FSM-transition. Risk: during ISS-012 investigation, this warn could be misread as a save failure or confused with the ISS-015 snapshot-IPC-drop path. Observed on saves 4 and 5 of a rapid-fire sequence (14:44:07 and 14:44:08 PDT).
resolution: Fixed in src/v2/engine.ts: inserted explicit else-if no-op branch for the case where snapshot_id is present, v2State is already EXPORTING, and v2SnapshotId matches the result. The spurious warn no longer fires on rapid-fire saves where onSnapshotPinned transitions the FSM before the RPC returns. All other unexpected states still warn. Patch is +2 lines, no deletions, typecheck clean.
title: v2SaveReplay "no snapshot_id" warn fires spuriously on rapid-fire saves despite snapshot_id being populated
